versions.changelog:
Initial release.

- Provides core Gaode Map (AMap) web API features: IP location, geocoding, reverse geocoding, and POI search.
- Supports searching by keyword, nearby locations, and city-based queries.
- Basic command-line usage included for each feature.
- Requires users to register and configure their own AMap API Key.
- Outputs results in both human-readable and optional JSON format.
